name: mstack-codex-review-workflow
description: Claude-led coordinator workflow for any task in a repository, from a list of issues (GitHub or another tracker), an execution plan, or one larger task. It splits the work into conflict-free lanes (parallel worktree agents or one agent in sequence), tracks each item as open, in progress or closed, reviews every lane with the advisor and a read-only Codex pass, integrates, and delivers one pull request with CI run one at a time. Claude Code only.
